name: A.M. Deviation
justification: One clean invariant (expression mod 3) gives a two-token solution; unique 0/1 answer.
solution_sketch: Each operation changes e = a1 + a3 - 2*a2 by 0 or +-3, so e mod 3 is invariant and e can reach anything in its residue class. Answer 0 if (a1+a2+a3) % 3 == 0 else 1.
